verdict.rationale: Dagster's docs say users can 'Use Dagster's UI or APIs' to run subsets of dbt models, which shows API/UI equivalence for one action. Nothing documents general API parity with the UI, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The MCP server and the dg CLI are separate surfaces belonging to other stories, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API reference, an explicit claim of UI/API parity, coverage of run launching, asset materialization, schedules/sensors and backfills via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use Dagster's UI or APIs to run subsets of your dbt models, seeds, and snapshots.
